author: Yffe
content: C5 string search/transform: emit the six ops (contains/starts_with/ends_with/find/split/trim) as verified TString methods in emit_string_search_methods + the occurs_at/contains_sub/count_sep/sep_free/is_space spec fns + lemma_count_push in emit_string_search_defs (lower.rs), gated by program_uses_string_search. starts_with/ends_with/find/split/trim added to BUILTIN_METHODS + the 5 spec fns to GENERATED_SPEC_FNS (validator.rs). The contains name-clash is resolved by Rust receiver-type method resolution (TString::contains substring vs TVec::contains membership). split's Vec<String> wrapper woven via collect_vec_elem_types when a C5 op is used. L1 runnable mirrors added. Grounded each op with real verus first (predicates+find 14/0, split 7/0, trim 8/0); pinned a true/Some case per #101.
